verdict.rationale: Attio's own docs say lists can be used to "model business processes" and that you can define custom objects and lists with a wide range of attribute types. Kanban views and stage-conversion and pipeline reporting suggest stage-based pipelines can be built from multiple lists. However, no evidence explicitly states that each pipeline or list can carry its own distinct stage set for different products or motions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of multiple pipelines with independent stage definitions, per-pipeline stage configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
